apps.localizedDescription:
Spitify:

Music, podcasts and audiobooks for Android and iPhone. Play your own files, find online music, stream it, or download it for offline listening. Listen on your phone or through your car’s playback controls. No Spitify account. Recommendations are learned on your device.

Android: Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Media3 | iPhone: SwiftUI · AVFoundation · iOS 17+.

iPhone:

Current iPhone simulator captures. Player screens use a generated test song; the album page shows an online search result.

Android:

Screenshots are from the Galaxy Z Fold8 emulator profile included in this repo, using generated test music.

🎵 Your music, Spotify-style:

• Home with quick picks, generated playlists, Jump back in, Recently added and top artists.

versions.localizedDescription:
Spitify 1.0.26 keeps your library the same on all your devices, and streams start right away.

• Songs found on another device: if a song from another device can't be found here, it's listed under Couldn't find on this device with a Retry button.
• Instant streaming: on desktop, streamed songs start in well under a second instead of several seconds. On Android, playback starts as soon as half a second is loaded, and the next song is loaded ahead.
• Settings in the sidebar: on desktop and on Android tablets and unfolded foldables. On desktop, your profile picture now opens your profile.

Desktop installers aren't signed yet:

• Mac: open Spitify once, then go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
• Windows: choose More info › Run anyway.

The iPhone download is unsigned for SideStore/AltStore. The Android APK installs directly.
